svg.text: Official Repos Production Board Layout, Age I Pyramid & Wonder Draft
5 random Progress Tokens face-up; 3 returned to box
Conflict Pawn starts on 0 • Reaching opponent's Capital = Instant Military Victory • Crossing Token = Opponent loses 2 or 5 coins once
Shuffle 23 Age I cards, remove 3 unseen; deal 5 overlapping rows
Accessibility Rule: Only cards NOT overlapped
by any card below may be taken (Row 5 starts open)
SETUP REFERENCE: WONDER DRAFT & AGE II / III DECK PREP
P1 picks 1 → P2 picks 2 → P1 takes remaining 1.
P2 picks 1 → P1 picks 2 → P2 takes remaining 1.
Only 7 Wonders can be constructed in the entire game.
Once the 7th is built, the 8th is returned to the box.
Building Card Colors & Age Deck Rules
• Brown / Gray: Raw Materials & Manufactured Goods
• Purple (Guilds — Age III): Shuffle 3 random Guilds
into Age III deck after removing 3 Age III cards.
Age II: Inverted pyramid • Age III: Diamond layout
Card Selection, 3 Action Choices, Chaining/Trading & Supremacy Checks
Choose 1 Accessible Face-Up Card from the Pyramid
Pick any face-up card that is completely uncovered by cards in lower rows.
You MUST use this card to perform exactly one of the three actions in Step 2 below.
STEP 2: RESOLVE ONE OF THREE ACTIONS WITH THE CHOSEN CARD
Place card face-up in your city
Free if you own the matching
Buy missing goods from bank for
Useful to deny key cards to
Check Instant Supremacy Victory & Science Pairs
• Each Shield advances Conflict Pawn 1 space.
• Crossing token line: opponent loses coins.
claim 1 face-up Progress Token from board.
Reveal Newly Uncovered Cards & Check Age End
1. Flip face-up any face-down pyramid cards that are no longer overlapped.
2. If cards remain in pyramid → Opponent takes next turn (unless you triggered "Play Again").
3. If pyramid is empty → Advance to next Age (Weaker military chooses who goes first in new Age).
* If Military Pawn is on 0 at Age end, the player who took the LAST card of the Age chooses start player.
END OF AGE III: CIVILIAN VICTORY SCORING (If No Supremacy Win)
Sum Victory Points (VP) across all 8 categories using the scorepad:
5. Built Wonders 6. Progress Tokens 7. Military Track (2 / 5 / 10 VP) 8. Treasury (1 VP per 3 Coins)
Highest Total VP Wins • Tie-Breaker: Most VP from Blue (Civilian) cards (if still tied, shared victory).
